capabilities: answer questions from your notes with numbered citations that open the source passages
show related notes by meaning in a sidebar and add links from them
proofread, rewrite, summarize or reformat selected text
distill fleeting notes into permanent notes and rename untitled notes and pasted images
extract sentences into tasks with due dates and draft a weekly review
extras: Mac desktop only; meaning-based features require the Mac's text embeddings while Ollama only covers the writing features on other desktops. Requires macOS 26 with Apple Intelligence and a one-time Xcode CLI build of a local helper. The meaning index is stored outside the vault in ~/Library/Caches/tahoe-intelligence. Reminders and Calendar integration are off by default. The directory listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Smart Connections and Tahoe Intelligence both show the notes related to the one you're reading
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistance, and cloud AI services mean sending private notes off-device; this runs the models locally on the user's Mac.

relations.evidence: With Tahoe Organize: inbox triage gets a suggested folder, tags and title for each note
days until Oct 14 = becomes a calculation, and Tahoe Math works it out exactly
Apple Intelligence can be the model for Tahoe Code's ghost text, ⌘I edits and equation to code
It all runs on your Mac with Apple Intelligence (free and private), or with a local Ollama model
Ollama can stand in for the model on any desktop, for writing help, distilling, tasks, reviews, renaming and maps

summary: On-device AI assistant for notes: answers questions from your notes with citations, finds related notes, rewrites text, distills notes and extracts tasks, using Apple Intelligence or Ollama.
